## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new `CRITERION_HINT` needs fixing. It tells users never to write "shall", but the validator option this PR keeps, `require_shall`, rejects any criterion that leaves it out.

## Changes
This PR rewrites `CRITERION_HINT` to ask for direct action bullets that leave out the word "shall". It also rewrites `BULLET_HINT` to show the exact `- ` prefix. The PR adds a one-line `review.txt` file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — Make the criterion hint match the require_shall option — With `require_shall: true`, a user who follows the hint and writes "- Save the result" is rejected. `app/criteria.py:7-8` returns `" shall " in text`, and `tests/test_criteria.py:20-21` checks that this exact input is rejected. — With `require_shall` enabled, the hint steers users into writing criteria that the validator rejects, and they get no guidance on how to fix them. — Fix: Show the "no shall" wording only when `require_shall` is false, or use wording that fits both modes.
